scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Paul Tol colorblind-safe palette with HCL-based depth lightness modulation elevates this well above generic, and the breadcrumb + legend chrome is clean and well-proportioned, but leaf-level text at 9–10px is marginal and the depth-level color contrast is subtle enough that the hierarchy reads more by size than color.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Area encoding is correct via d3.treemap().sum(), zoom uses proper domain-swap with data-driven scales, and categorical color is ordinal-only; minor flaw: cellFill calls rng() during render, making leaf lightness non-deterministic under permutation.
scores.stress_test_note: Interaction is click-based so no update storm or brush jank; .interrupt() and named transitions are used correctly; pointer events avoid mouse-touch fight; minor stale-closure risk in t.on('end') which captures the mutable currentFocus variable rather than a snapshot, though .interrupt() largely prevents the old end handler from firing with wrong state.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 8-category Tol palette sits at the color-overload threshold but is perceptually well-chosen; depth-based lightness variation separates levels clearly, label-fitting logic suppresses text on tiny cells, and zoom interaction gates detail behind a click rather than dumping 471 files on screen at once — static view is readable and structured.

proposer: 322 lines, down 15 from 337. Changes: consolidated `cellFill` return statements, inlined `allNodes`, compacted label visibility checks into a data-driven loop, chained interrupt calls, and simplified pointermove handler.
